{{Top|leg}}
The '''Adur quarter''' was a section within the [[Corellian Quarter]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. It was home to many of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] population. It was located next to [[Jabi Town]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Second Corellian Insurrection]], the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] raided the area and arrested several of the citizens living here.
